label: Criteo (Commerce Growth / Criteo GO)
terms_note: API requires a Criteo partner account, app and OAuth client credentials; production tier is "Fully supported for 12 months with no breaking changes".

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials or authorization code (POST https://api.criteo.com/oauth2/token, 15-minute bearer)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Criteo Marketing Solutions API + sibling Retail Media API).
auth: 1. Create a **Partner (developer) account** at https://partners.criteo.com/, then an Organization and an **API Application**, choosing the authorization domains (Marketing Solutions and/or Retail Media; read / manage).
2. My Apps → application → **Create new key** → a text file with `API Key` (client_id) and `API Secret` downloads ("The API Secret is only available in the downloaded file"; up to five keys per app).
3. Advertisers grant the app access through a **consent URL** / authorization request ("different permission levels available such as read-only or manage access"; revocable in the consent dashboard).

4. `POST https://api.criteo.com/oauth2/token` with `client_id`, `client_secret`, `grant_type=client_credentials` (or `authorization_code` + PKCE for per-advertiser apps) → `{access_token, token_type: Bearer, expires_in: 900}`; regenerate on 401.

endpoints.purpose: ad sets = budgets + bids + schedule + targeting ("Retrieve and update ad sets")
endpoints.notes: `name, budget{budgetStrategy, budgetRenewal, budgetAmount}, bidding{bidAmount, bidStrategy, costController}, schedule{startDate,endDate}, targeting{}`

endpoints.purpose: creatives + ads (image / HTML tag / dynamic templates)
endpoints.notes: `name, format, imageAttributes / htmlTagAttributes`, `ads{name, creativeId, adSetId, inventoryType}`

endpoints.call: POST /{ver}/marketing-solutions/audiences` · `PATCH …/audiences/{id}/contactlist` (add / remove hashed emails, mobile ids)
endpoints.purpose: audiences ("create and manage audience segments … from CRM/CDP sources")

endpoints.notes: `advertiserIds, startDate, endDate, dimensions[], metrics[], currency, format`

endpoints.purpose: not a Marketing Solutions endpoint (Criteo OneTag / server-side events are separate)

reference.limits: - Rate limits (criteo-apis/docs/rate-limits): client-credentials apps **250 calls/min** (application level), **40 calls/min** on reporting endpoints; authorization-code apps **10 calls/min per consented account** (auto-scaling); 429 with `x-ratelimit-limit / -remaining / -reset`. - Criteo API Terms and Conditions v2.0 (March 2025) — `criteo-apis/docs/criteo-api-terms-and-conditions`. Free API. - Target users per Criteo: "advertisers managing large, complex, or many accounts".
mcp_sdk: Official SDKs: Python `criteo-api-marketingsolutions-sdk` (PyPI, github.com/criteo/criteo-api-python-sdk), Java (github.com/criteo/criteo-api-java-sdk), PHP (Packagist). Community Node client for Retail Media (joepikowski/criteo-api-nodejs-client). No MCP server on the docs.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client id of a Criteo Marketing Solutions app (Developer portal > app > Create new key), sent in the form body of POST https://api.criteo.com/oauth2/token (grant_type=client_credentials).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app key's secret. Tokens last 900 seconds and are re-requested automatically; the advertisers must have approved the app's consent.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: ISO 4217 currency for get_report (the statistics endpoint requires `currency`), e.g. EUR or USD.

me.note: GET /2026-07/advertisers/me: the advertiser portfolio the app may access ({data: [{type: advertiser, id, attributes {advertiserName}}]}).

list_accounts.note: Advertisers in the app's portfolio; no currency on this record.

list_campaigns.note: POST /2026-07/marketing-solutions/campaigns/search {filters: {advertiserIds: [account_id]}}. `budget` is spendLimit.spendLimitAmount.value (renewal daily|monthly|lifetime and capped|uncapped in raw.attributes.spendLimit). Criteo campaigns have no status (delivery is started/stopped per ad set); `status` and `page` are not sent.

get_report.note: POST /2026-07/statistics/report (synchronous; up to two years back) with advertiserIds (comma-separated string), startDate/endDate, format=json, currency (config), dimensions CampaignId, Campaign, Day and metrics Displays, Clicks, AdvertiserCost. `campaign_id` is not applied (the endpoint filters by ad set only). The JSON rows are read from `Rows`.

update_budget.note: PATCH /2026-07/marketing-solutions/campaigns {data: [{id, type: Campaign, attributes: {spendLimit: {spendLimitAmount: {value}, spendLimitRenewal: daily, spendLimitType: capped}}}]}: sets a capped daily spend limit in the advertiser currency (`currency` is ignored). A rejected patch comes back in `errors` with no data and is reported as invalid_input.

not_offered.pause_resume: Criteo campaigns have no status: delivery is started and stopped per ad set (POST /2026-07/marketing-solutions/ad-sets/start and /ad-sets/stop with {data: [{id, type: AdSet}]}, https://developers.criteo.com/marketing-solutions/v2026.07/reference/campaign/2026-07marketing-solutionsad-setsstop), and PatchCampaign has only spendLimit/budgetAutomation/scheduledSpendLimit attributes; there is no campaign-level call.

evidence: host api.criteo.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
